metadata.name: GetCreditBureauReporting
metadata.description: This API is used to Get Credit Bureau report.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values : 0-9 Example: 12345 Condition: At least one of AccountID/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Example:7314145404 Condition: At least one of AccountID/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXX Example: 12345 Condition: At least one of AccountID/AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: ApplicantType
request_fields.description: Selects the type of Applicants. Valid Values: 1,2,3,4 Example: 1 = Applicant, 2 = Co-Applicant , 3 = Cosigner , 4 = Secondary Card

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CBRIndicator
children.description: Indicates the CBR value Valid Values: 0-9 Format: xx Example: 1 = Yes

children.name: ECOACode
children.description: Credit Report Details Association Code (ECOA) Valid Values: Refer Appendix section 5.36 Format: xx Example:  1

children.name: CBRDate
children.description: Indicates the Credit Bureau Reporting  date Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: SpecialCommentsOverrideValue
children.description: Displays the special comments Valid Values: Refer Appendix section 5.58 Format: xx Example: A = Account acquired by FDIC/NCUA. Allowable Values: 2

children.name: SpecialCommentsDerivedValue
children.description: Displayes the derived value of Compliance Condition Code Valid Values: a-z Format: xx Example:A = Account acquired by FDIC/NCUA. Allowable Values: 2

children.name: SpecialCommentsLastReportedValue
children.description: Displayes the Last Reported value of special comment. Valid Values: a-z Format: xx Example: A = Account acquired by FDIC/NCUA. Allowable Values: 2

children.name: ComplianceConditionCodeOverrideValue
children.description: Displays the Compliance code Valid Values: Refer Appendix section 5.59 Format: xx Example: NO = NONE Allowable Values: 2

children.name: ComplianceConditionCodeDerivedValue
children.description: Displayes the derived value of Compliance Condition Code. Valid Values: a-z Format: xx Example: NO = NONE Allowable Values: 2

children.name: ComplianceConditionCodeLastReportedValue
children.description: Displays the Compliance code Valid Values: a-z Format: xx Example: NO = NONE Allowable Values: 2

children.name: CustomerInformationIndicator
children.description: Indicates the Customer Information Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format: xx Example:1A Allowable Values: 100

children.name: AuthorizedUserCBRIndicator
children.description: Indicates the authorised user Valid Values: 0-1, Null Format:x Example: 0 = No, 1 = Yes Allowable Values: 5

children.name: ClientId
children.description: Client ID of the client. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXX Example: 5558547 Allowable Values: 25

children.name: CoApplicantDeceased
children.description: This tag reflects whether the card holder is deceased or not . Valid Values:0- No, 1 - Yes Example: 0

children.name: BankruptcyNotificationDate
children.description: Indicates Bankrupt notification date Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: CoApplicantCBRConsumerInfoIndicator
children.description: This tag reflect the Co-Applicant consumer information indicator. Valid Values: Format:xx Example:1A Allowable Values: 2

children.name: CbBnkrptNotifDate
children.description: Indicates Bankrupt notification date Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: Deceased
children.description: Flag for card holder is deceased or not Valid Values: 0- No, 1 - Yes, Null Format: x Example: 0 Allowable Values: 5

children.name: FCRA1stDateOfDelinquency
children.description: 1st date of delinquency (Fair Credit Reporting Act) Valid Values: 0 - 9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

children.name: CardRelationship
children.description: Indicates the Secondary Card relation to the Primary Card. Valid Values: 0- Authorized User (Default Value) , 1 -Co-Owner Example:0 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: DateAccountClosed
children.description: Indicates the date when account was closed. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

children.name: BankruptcyDischargeDate
children.description: Description: Indicates the date when bankruptcy was discharged. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

children.name: SendK1Segment
children.description: This flag specifies if K1 Segment need to be included in Credit Bureau Reporting or not. 1 = Yes. 0 = No. Valid Values: 0,1 Example: 1

children.name: K1OriginalCreditorName
children.description: The name of the company/creditor that originally opened the account for the consumer. Valid Values: A-Z Example: Excel Finance LLC Allowable Values: 30

children.name: K1CreditorClassification
children.description: Contains a code which must be reported to indicate the general type of business for the Original Creditor Name. Valid Values: 01 = Retail 02 = Medical/Health Care Required when reporting medical debts... 03 = Oil Company 04 = Government 05 = Personal Services 06 = Insurance 07 = Educational 08 = Banking 09 = Rental/Leasing 10 = Utilities 11 = Cable/Cellular 12 = Financial (other non-banking financial institutions) 13 = Credit Union 14 =  Automotive 15 = Check Guarantee Example: 02 Allowable Values: 30
